set.body: Implement docs/plans/2026-10-27-graphics-api.md under VISION section 7. Start with a Skia reuse decision: pinned C ABI/artifacts, Scala Native raster/GPU path, device and presentation ownership, text consistency, lifecycle and measured costs. Do not assume Dawn/wgpu handle interoperability. G-1 freezes the browser capability inventory and budgets; G-2 is the Stage 2 public graphics nucleus; G-3/G-4 require the full matrix, visual/performance evidence and public-only Intaglio integration including its separately qualified Native port. All graphics implementation and native probes remain unqualified; preserve existing native gates and obtain explicit design revisions for any changed rendering responsibilities.
set.title: G-0–G-4: Qualify public graphics, starting with Skia reuse feasibility
